newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-SUSPENSION-PLAGUED MARSEILLE COPE WITHOUT ABSENTEES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SUSPENSION-PLAGUED MARSEILLE COPE WITHOUT ABSENTEES.

text.p: No French team have had more players booked or sent off this season than Marseille who have yet to field the same line-up in successive matches.

The trip to Strasbourg on Sunday will be no different with Italian central defender Ivan Franceschini suspended after becoming the fourth Marseille player to be sent off in 10 games in the 2-1 home win over Guingamp in midweek.
Add to that the absence on international duty of German goalkeeper Andreas Koepke, striker Tony Cascarino of Ireland and Tunisia's Medhi Ben Slimane.
"When I have a full squad, I'll probably have tricky choices to make," joked coach Gerard Gili, whose players have also picked up 24 bookings.
Striker Xavier Gravelaine, Marseille's top scorer with four goals, said: "It's not easy to change the face of the team for each match, even if we've not done too badly."
Down to 10 men just before the interval against Guingamp, promoted Marseille still won and are eighth, six points behind leaders Paris St Germain and three behind Bastia.

Marseille's problems have been in defence -- Franceschini's compatriot and occasional centre-back partner Alberto Malusci has also been sent off -- but Gili believes referees have been too harsh on his team.
"The referees should distinguish more often between unintentional actions and voluntary anti-football," he said.
Club president Jean-Michel Roussier said: "The squad is both the victim of a false reputation of hardness inherited from the past and their inexperience of the first division."

On the plus side, midfielder Eric Roy returns from suspension and Yordan Lechkov has been allowed by Bulgaria to play on Sunday before joining their squad for the World Cup qualifier away to Luxembourg on Tuesday.

Also, Strasbourg, who shocked previously unbeaten Bordeaux with a 2-1 midweek victory at their home ground, are weakened in defence without Jan Suchoparek, who has joined Euro 96 runners- up Czech Republic for their World Cup qualifier at home to Spain on Wednesday.
